description: jungle half cover at battle camera ~25 units and close-up
texture: Matte grey-green stone, dark green moss patches and shallow brown root relief hugging the surface. Broad coherent color regions, no text or logos, no gloss.

variants.A: Original stylized chunky matte science fiction tactics prop. Broad readable planar shapes, all sides finished. One compact solid rectangular block of ancient mossy stone blocks, about as wide as tall, width 1.2 times height, deep footprint. Thick flat top, continuous solid body reaching the ground, beveled chunky edges. No ground plate, platform, vehicles, wheels, legs, posts, arches, holes, floating pieces, gloss or rounded shapes.
variants.B: Original stylized chunky matte science fiction tactics prop. Broad readable planar shapes, all sides finished. A squat compact cuboid of ancient mossy stone blocks, width 1.25 times height, depth equal to height. Single broad solid stone barricade with shallow horizontal seam, flat thick top, very slightly chipped corners. Wider than tall but not a long wall. No ground plate, platform, vehicles, wheels, legs, posts, arches, holes, floating pieces, gloss or rounded shapes.
variants.C: A single solid nearly cubic block of moss-covered grey-green stone. Width 110 centimeters, height 90 centimeters, depth 85 centimeters. This is a compact cube, slightly wider than tall, NOT a wall or tower. Broad flat top, solid uninterrupted body to ground, minimal shallow surface cracks. Stylized chunky matte game prop. No base, ground plate, feet, posts, arches, wheels, holes, loose debris, rounded surfaces, gloss or floating pieces.
variants.D: One massive roughly cube-shaped boulder hewn from moss-covered grey-green stone, all six faces flat and square, softly chipped corners. Width 1.15 times height, depth 0.95 times height. Single solid block, clean geometric cuboid silhouette. Original stylized matte tactics game prop. No long wall, tower, stacked courses, cap slab, pedestal, ground plate, legs, arches, vehicle, gloss or floating pieces.
